events_seen: FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 11 (2 days ago)): Ryan added Jalen Brooks (WR, ARI) (dropped Odell Beckham (WR, MIN)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 10 (3 days ago)): Ryan added Odell Beckham (WR, MIN) (dropped Demarcus Robinson (WR, SF)).
FREE AGENT ADD (Oct 10 (3 days ago)): Charles added Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (Oct 08 (5 days ago)): Mitchum added Dameon Pierce (RB, PHI) for $1 FAAB (dropped Jacob Cowing (WR, SF)).

WEEK 5 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Jake, 145.9-124.3; Shaq def. Adam, 112.0-99.9; Fronge def. Drew, 158.0-94.0 (BLOWOUT); Charles def. Mitchum, 201.4-105.1 (BLOWOUT); Kevin def. Brent, 150.1-146.2 (NAIL-BITER); Ryan def. Wingard, 174.4-87.9 (BLOWOUT)

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 5 is fully graded and Charles is 10-0. That sentence exists. The Ledger this week does not bury the lede — the cover line is 'Is This Over?' and the answer inside is more complicated than the record suggests, but not by much.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Two locks, two wins on the season. I know Ruckman is also 2-0 on locks and I know he's going to make this a whole thing, but my record is 7-5 and I picked against the grain twice and cashed both times. The methodology is sound.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Someone on this network needs to give me a dedicated locks segment before Week 6 kicks off. I am 8-4 overall, 2-0 on locks, and I watch Terrence Odom call himself a second-half pundit at 5-7 with no consequences. There should be consequences.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Ruckman wants a segment. I want a time machine to un-pick Brent's defense in Week 5. We don't always get what we want, Bo. The board is public, mine says 5-7, and I'm still here. That's called resilience.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Ryan added Odell Beckham on Saturday and dropped him for Jalen Brooks on Sunday. That is a 48-hour asset lifecycle. AEGIS is at $124.13 on the exchange and the front office is speed-running the waiver wire like it's 2019. The championship did not cure the chaos.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Kevin vs Wingard this week is not a preview, it's a referendum. RDC is 7-3 and trying to shake off the Brent ambush from last week. SDR is 3-7, $56.11 on the board, and Wingard has not found a trade partner all offseason. Kevin should win this one going away and he knows he needs the margin.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: ForgeHammer at $88.66 after that 158-point performance against Drew — I called the Havana relocation a distraction, not a death sentence, and Fronge is 4-6 with serious upside if the schedule opens up. The market is starting to agree. That's a +12.8% window for a reason.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Atlas Rebuild Works scores 94 points in a blowout loss and Drew is 0-10. ATLAS closed at $40.72 last board. The liquidation-risk conversation has moved from background noise to the only conversation anyone in this building wants to have about that franchise.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: ADAM VS CHARLES THIS WEEK. HELIX IS 2-8. CROWN IS 10-0 WITH 912 POINTS SCORED. THIS IS NOT A MATCHUP. THIS IS AN INSPECTION.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Power rankings are unavailable this cycle and I will not be issuing a placeholder. What I will say is that Mitchum at 6-4 with 712 points scored after getting handled 201-105 by Charles still belongs in the top half of any serious list, and anyone who drops DEEP out of the top six on one bad week is reacting, not ranking.
